title.zh: 币安遭黑客攻击后出现 16 亿美元清算，比特币价格指标暗示将反弹
title.en: Bitcoin price metrics hint at rebound as $1.6B liquidations follow Binance hack

current_state.zh: 市场消化币安63亿美元黑客事件，比特币维持在76,000美元上方，但加密货币相关股票大幅下挫，Coinbase领跌逾13%。
current_state.en: Markets are absorbing the $6.3B Binance hack, with Bitcoin holding above $76,000 while crypto-related equities sold off sharply, led by Coinbase down over 13%.

updates.title_zh: 币安遭黑客攻击后出现 16 亿美元清算，比特币价格指标暗示将反弹
updates.title_en: Bitcoin price metrics hint at rebound as $1.6B liquidations follow Binance hack
updates.what_changed_zh: 比特币在触及 76,320 美元后维持在 76,000 美元上方，市场消化了据报道的 63 亿美元币安黑客攻击以及同时发生的美国科技股抛售，24 小时内加密货币清算额超过 15 亿美元，四小时 RSI 显示看涨背离。
updates.what_changed_en: Bitcoin held above $76,000 after touching $76,320 as markets absorbed a reported $6.3 billion Binance hack and a concurrent US tech-stock sell-off, with over $1.5 billion in crypto liquidations in 24 hours and four-hour RSI showing a bullish divergence.

updates.title_zh: 63 亿美元币安黑客攻击后，Coinbase 领跌加密概念股
updates.title_en: Coinbase leads crypto stock selloff following $6.3B Binance hack
updates.what_changed_zh: 加密货币相关股票在币安63亿美元黑客事件后大幅下跌，Coinbase跌超13%，Circle、Strategy、IREN、Figure跌8-10%。
updates.what_changed_en: Crypto-linked stocks sold off sharply following the $6.3B Binance hack, with Coinbase falling over 13% and Circle, Strategy, IREN, and Figure dropping 8-10%.

updates.current_state_en: Markets are absorbing the $6.3B Binance hack, with Bitcoin holding above $76,000 while crypto-related equities sold off sharply, led by Coinbase down over 13%.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Crypto-linked equities sold off sharply Friday, with Coinbase falling over 13% and Circle, Strategy, IREN and Figure dropping 8-10%, as markets absorbed Binance's $6.3 billion security breach alongside Coinbase's weaker third-quarter revenue.
